headline: How to Get Stellarys
title: How to Get Stellarys in Aniimo | Celestis Level 18 Evolution | Aniimo Guide
video_script: Stellarys is a Dark damage dealer found in the Forest of Falling Stars. To get one, raise a Celestis to level eighteen. Then defeat an Alpha Stellarys, which appears in that same forest, to unlock the evolution. Celestis spawns in several Breezy Plains areas, so catch one in the Forest of Falling Stars to level faster. Do you run Stellarys on your team? Comment below!
description: Stellarys in Aniimo evolves from Celestis at level 18 after you defeat an Alpha Stellarys in the Forest of Falling Stars.
